en.hubeali:
From him, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Abu Jameela Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Jabir Bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>

having said regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:83] and you shall speak to the people good words: ‘Speak good words to the people, better than what you would love to be spoken regarding yourselves’.
en.sarwar: 10. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ibn abu Najran from abu Jamilah al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Jabir ibn Yazid from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

About the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘. . . speak righteous words to people, . . .’ [2:83] the Imam said, ‘It means say to people the best of that which you love to be said about you.’”
